reviewItems.description: Review deployed dashboard, hosted UI, auth runtime, admin portal, and customer proxy responses for HSTS, frame, MIME sniffing, referrer, permissions, and cache-control headers.
Review CSP for dashboard, hosted UI, and admin portal; document required OAuth, passkey, bot-protection, image, script, style, and connect-src allowances.
Verify session, cross-domain handoff, MFA, device, and hosted UI cookies use appropriate HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, domain, path, and expiry attributes.
Verify trusted origin enforcement, CORS behavior, CSRF posture, hosted UI origin handling, and customer-app callback origin handling.
Inspect logs and error reporting to confirm API keys, OAuth secrets, OTPs, tokens, cookies, webhook secrets, and vault material are never logged.
Review provider callback URLs, redirect allowlists, state handling, and customer-app return URLs for open-redirect and origin-confusion risks.
Verify provider credential changes require least-privilege admin access, audit events, and post-change validation.
Verify audit retention, external sink delivery, status reporting, incident timeline capture, and support-access visibility.
